decisions.statement: Ranking is min-gated on the weakest evidence family, never a weighted average
decisions.support: Local anti-averaging rule: a single T1 family pins the block at T1 regardless of eight T4s; averaging would let unresolved rights be compensated
decisions.falsifier: Min-gating proves degenerate (all assets pin to one tier) AND averaging demonstrably does not admit rights-compromised assets

decisions.statement: Rank by observed adaptation cost, not popularity metadata
decisions.support: A22 stars-predict-quality is unproven/weak; A07 adaptation cost unknown
decisions.falsifier: Metadata ranking matches outcome ranking over N builds

decisions.statement: Select estimators honest at n=10; frequentist A/B is disqualified
decisions.support: Regime is tens of expensive observations, not millions of free ones
decisions.falsifier: Posteriors remain too diffuse to separate candidates even with correct estimators

decisions.statement: Cold start is the only case that currently exists
decisions.support: Zero accepted plans, edits, incidents, maintenance outcomes, admitted blocks
decisions.falsifier: Production data appears that makes warm-start the dominant case

decisions.statement: Registry-health scorers, not recommenders, supply the scoring shape
decisions.support: OpenSSF Scorecard, ecosyste.ms, SourceRank, Renovate merge-confidence score assets on evidence; recommenders score users on preferences
decisions.falsifier: A recommender formulation outperforms an evidence-scoring formulation on asset selection

decisions.statement: Falsified-belief records are a first-class output
decisions.support: AutoSaaS lists failed assumptions as an update target; absent from the entire external census
decisions.falsifier: Falsified-belief records prove unusable or unmaintained in practice

decisions.statement: Exploration is permitted over quality, never over safety
decisions.support: Exploration means using a less-proven capability on a paying client's project
decisions.falsifier: A safety-relevant exploration proves necessary and acceptable

decisions.statement: UNDERDETERMINED aggregates are contract defects, not model failures
decisions.support: Composition architecture names this the single most valuable output for the contract lane
decisions.falsifier: UNDERDETERMINED results trace to model error rather than missing contract fields

decisions.statement: Catalogue size must never be a ranking signal
decisions.support: OpenConnector: 1,445 providers and 15,156 actions with a tenancy-unsafe storage model would have ranked top
decisions.falsifier: Catalogue breadth correlates with production reuse quality

decisions.statement: Cross-client aggregation availability is unknown and gates the premise
decisions.support: Client-private work; no contractual determination exists
decisions.falsifier: A client owner confirms or refuses anonymised cross-client aggregation

decisions.statement: Commercial ~100 target is not_applicable; there is no coherent market of production-learning-loop vendors
decisions.support: Threefold: Azure AI Personalizer (the category's flagship managed service) retired 25 Aug 2026 with the migration path being the microsoft/learning-loop OSS repo, not a successor; every genuine loop found is a feature inside another product category (Renovate merge confidence, v0 autofixer, Algolia Dynamic Re-Ranking) with no analyst category or competitive set; and the nearest true analogue is deliberately unbuilt — deps.dev and OpenSSF Scorecard contain no outcome feedback at all, while Renovate's is private. Built 22 records across 7 weighted categories instead.
decisions.falsifier: A set of ~100 vendors can be assembled that position against each other on production-feedback-loop quality

decisions.statement: Package-health scoring is the closest analogue and it contains no outcome feedback — the gap Actionist would fill is real
decisions.support: deps.dev and OpenSSF Scorecard are static analysis of repository state with no production-outcome signal; Mend's Renovate merge confidence is the only surveyed system pooling real cross-project outcomes and its algorithm is private. So outcome-based reranking of software assets is rare rather than standard.
decisions.falsifier: An existing package-health service is shown to ingest production outcomes and rerank on them
decisions.limitations: absence established across the surveyed set, not proven across all vendors
